headline: AI Backlash Hits Big-City Schools as Evidence Questions Mount
thesis: New York City and Los Angeles have pulled back student-facing AI while new data suggests higher ed's AI integration is overhyped.
summary: EdSurge reports on the backlash against classroom AI, with NYC announcing a one-year moratorium on student-facing generative AI and Los Angeles removing it from district devices. Inside Higher Ed cites Instructure data showing faculty AI tool use lags hype, and Brookings' Global Task Force continues to say risks currently outweigh benefits for students. ISTE+ASCD has announced its rebrand as the International Society for Transforming Education. Coming up: EdTech Week (Oct 14-15, NYC) and the 1EdTech Technical Congress (Oct 19-21, Milwaukee).
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · October 6, 2026 · Most publisher sites were not directly fetched, so items come from search-indexed results; several sources had no new dated news and list evergreen items with notes.
